title: Unfold radical material from the same bundle
summary: Split target radical presentation into independently clipped hook and overbar material owners, staggered their reveal from the shared seed, hid the native target only during reconciliation, and constrained KaTeX wide SVG geometry inside measured fragment owners.

sourceRefs.summary: Creates hook and overbar material frames with separate timing, clipping, and local motion.
Supports clipped structural fragments while constraining native KaTeX SVG geometry to measured owner bounds.
Proves two differently timed and clipped radical fragments replace the native glyph during act and disappear at native settlement.
